scopeLimits: All observed assertions retain the original product SHA, snapshot SHA, run/job/attempt and run conclusion; selected PASS from a failing run never changes that run to success.
Only the two exact C2 named training tests are included; filtered/unobserved tests are not counted.

The graph includes literal relative imports/exports, type imports, side effects and literal dynamic imports/requires. Package internals, computed paths and generated/build entrypoints are outside this static comparison.
Hosted fixture authority, source declarations, seed choices, SQLite/provider proofs and HTTP/service responses do not become installed UI/native/MCP or business-human acceptance.
Global typecheck remains a separate gate. Zero own diagnostics does not turn foreign diagnostics or resident/global acceptance green.
The audit is metadata-only; no product, tests, typecheck, guards, install, build, remote mutation, merge or deployment was executed.
